# Third-party notices (JAgentDesk vendored copy)

This directory is a modified copy of archify 3.0.1 (MIT, see `LICENSE`).

## Brand marks: removed

Upstream archify embeds optional third-party brand marks (vector path data
generated from Simple Icons 16.28.0, plus an OpenAI mark), some of which carry
their own licenses or trademark terms (for example Angular CC-BY-4.0, Apache
Airflow and Apache Kafka Apache-2.0, Jenkins CC-BY-SA-3.0, Rust CC-BY-SA-4.0,
Vue.js CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0). **This copy contains none of them.** The brand-mark
catalog is deleted and brand rendering is replaced by a stub that rejects any
`brand` field; see `README.md`, "Patches".

## JetBrains Mono

Rendered viewer artifacts embed the JetBrains Mono variable font subsets served
by Google Fonts (embedded as base64 in `assets/template.html`; rendering makes
no network request). JetBrains Mono is maintained at
[github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)
and is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The complete license
text is preserved in `assets/JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt` and in the font CSS carried
by every rendered HTML file.

## No additional rights granted

Brand names and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.
